liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Alabama Getaway** (3 reviews): Closing the first set, it reminded the reviewer of the early 1980s; The jam at the end seemed to go on forever and had a good groove [13][14][15]
- **Visions Of Johanna** (3 reviews): Reviewer calls Visions a nice moment in a show where Jerry seemed out of sorts; Called the highlight of the show, though reviewer says 1995 had better versions [5][6][15]
- **Good Morning Little Schoolgirl** (2 reviews): Reviewer rarely heard this song and disliked the new arrangement; Reviewer treats this as a rare treat, seldom played after the 1960s [6][13]
- **Queen Jane Approximately** (1 review): Reviewer calls Queen Jane exceptional within a sweetly played first set [12]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer calls this China>Rider the best of 1995, with a hopeful feel and real energy [9]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Reviewer names Looks Like Rain as the point where the show really gets good [12]

## Setlist highlights

- **Good Morning Little Schoolgirl**: back after 133 archived shows (586 days) [16]
- **Visions Of Johanna**: rare: 10 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1995-03-30.sbd.miller.119786.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 169 min; rated 4/5 by 7 [1]
- **gd95-03-30.sbd.4161.sbeok.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 21 songs; 165 min; rated 3.12/5 by 14 [3]. Said about its sound: FM soundboard with very hissy high end, recalling early tape-collecting days [12]
- **gd1995-03-30.fob.schoeps.wklitz.95823.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 175 min [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer found Garcia unfocused and the band tired that night [4]
- Reviewer attended every Atlanta show in 1995; this was the last time they saw Jerry [5]
- Reviewer sat in fourth row center [6]
- Reviewer's last Omni show; walking into the arena always felt like boarding a spaceship [10]
- Old VW buses drove past huge downtown Atlanta skyscrapers outside the venue [14]
- After Alabama Getaway, the band tuned to Beer Barrel Polka [1]
- Reviewer rates the 3-27-95 show as better than this one [5]
- Shoreline's China>Rider is a close second; far better than the reviewer's 1994 Autzen Stadium one [9]
- Reviewer has seen the band play better, but found this show memorable [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-03-30.sbd.miller.119786.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat -> Cassette Master -> Dat (48k) [1]
- **gd95-03-30.sbd.4161.sbeok.shnf**: source: dsbd (pre-fm)> ?> cdr> eac> shn [3]. Also: Reviewer believes the source came from someone taping the ear monitor signal, a UHF band rather than FM [8]
- **gd1995-03-30.fob.schoeps.wklitz.95823.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Ace Cubby; source: Schoeps MK4's>Reutelhuber Preamp>Teac DA-P20 [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead The Omni - March 30, 1995](https://www.dead.net/show/march-30-1995) [17]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1995-03-30 Grateful Dead Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1995-03-30-grateful-dead-ticket/) [18]
